title: Rangor
introBefore: The team agreed on a decision — three weeks later the code goes the old way again. Rangor pulls what matters from Jira, Confluence, and Slack and warns when a change fights those agreements. Product:
features: Fewer costly reworks: it flags when new work contradicts decisions already made.
One clear brief instead of five open tabs: what matters, the risks, and what changed.
The same context in the tools your engineers already use — no manual copy-paste across chats and docs.
Time back on every task: no rebuilding the story from scattered threads.
See at a glance what’s still debated — and what’s already decided.
Hints get sharper over time — based on what actually helped on past work.
footer: Rangor · team decisions don’t get lost in chat
